code: # === PyGen 注入：HTTP/SSL 韧性层（通用） === # 说明： # 1) 优先保持 verify=True；如确需临时绕过（不推荐），可设置环境变量 PYGEN_INSECURE_SSL=1 # 2) 默认遇到 418/403/429 仅做一次"预热 cookie + 浏览器化 headers"的重试 # 3) 若仍被拦截且本机已安装 Playwright，会自动尝试一次 request-context 兜底 # 如需禁用：设置 PYGEN_DISABLE_PLAYWRIGHT_FALLBACK=1 import os as _pygen_os import ssl as _pygen_ssl import urllib.parse as _pygen_urlparse try: # truststore 会让 Python/requests 使用系统证书库（Windows/macOS/Linux），更贴近浏览器行为 import truststore as _pygen_truststore # type: ignore _pygen_truststore.inject_into_ssl() except Exception: _pygen_truststore = None # noqa: F401 try: import requests as _pygen_requests from requests.structures import CaseInsensitiveDict as _pygen_CaseInsensitiveDict except Exception: _pygen_requests = None # noqa: F401 _PYGEN_DEFAULT_UA = ( "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) " "AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) " "Chrome/122.0 Safari/537.36" ) def _pygen_origin(url: str) -> str: try: p = _pygen_urlparse.urlsplit(url) return f"{p.scheme}://{p.netloc}" except Exception: return "" def _pygen_merge_headers(h: dict | None) -> dict: base = { "User-Agent": _PYGEN_DEFAULT_UA, "Accept": "application/json,text/plain,*/*", "Accept-Language": "zh-CN,zh;q=0.9,en;q=0.8", "Connection": "keep-alive", } if h: for k, v in h.items(): if v is not None: base[k] = v return base def _pygen_make_response(status: int, url: str, headers: dict, body: bytes): r = _pygen_requests.Response() r.status_code = status r.url = url r.headers = _pygen_CaseInsensitiveDict(headers or {}) r._content = body or b"" return r def _pygen_playwright_fetch(method: str, url: str, headers: dict, data=None, json=None, timeout: int = 30): """ 兜底：使用 Playwright 的 request context（更像浏览器/更容易过 WAF）。 仅当已安装 playwright 且未设置 PYGEN_DISABLE_PLAYWRIGHT_FALLBACK=1 时启用。 """ if _pygen_os.getenv("PYGEN_DISABLE_PLAYWRIGHT_FALLBACK") == "1": return None try: from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright # type: ignore except Exception: return None with sync_playwright() as p: ctx = p.request.new_context(ignore_https_errors=_pygen_os.getenv("PYGEN_INSECURE_SSL") == "1", extra_http_headers=headers) try: resp = ctx.fetch(url, method=method.upper(), data=data, json=json, timeout=timeout * 1000) body = resp.body() return _pygen_make_response(resp.status, url, dict(resp.headers), body) finally: ctx.dispose() def _pygen_install_requests_patch(): if _pygen_requests is None: return _orig = _pygen_requests.sessions.Session.request def _patched(self, method, url, **kwargs): # 默认超时，避免脚本卡死 kwargs.setdefault("timeout", 30) # 证书校验策略：默认开启；仅在用户明确设置时关闭 if _pygen_os.getenv("PYGEN_INSECURE_SSL") == "1": kwargs["verify"] = False # 合并"更像浏览器"的 headers（很多站会对 UA/Accept 做拦截） headers = _pygen_merge_headers(kwargs.get("headers")) kwargs["headers"] = headers # 首次请求 try: resp = _orig(self, method, url, **kwargs) except Exception as e: # 若是 SSL 校验错误：truststore 已注入则直接抛出；否则给出更友好的提示 msg = str(e) if "CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED" in msg or "certificate verify failed" in msg: # 若 playwright 可用，尝试用 request-context 做一次兜底（有些环境下系统信任链更完整） try: pw_resp = _pygen_playwright_fetch(method, url, headers=headers, data=kwargs.get("data"), json=kwargs.get("json"), timeout=int(kwargs.get("timeout") or 30)) if pw_resp is not None: return pw_resp except Exception: pass raise raise # WAF/反爬：做一次轻量重试（预热 cookie + 再请求） if resp is not None and getattr(resp, "status_code", 0) in (418, 403, 429): try: origin = _pygen_origin(url) if origin: # 预热：访问首页拿 cookie _ = _orig(self, "GET", origin + "/", headers=headers, timeout=15, verify=kwargs.get("verify", True)) resp2 = _orig(self, method, url, **kwargs) if resp2 is not None and getattr(resp2, "status_code", 0) not in (418, 403, 429): return resp2 # 若仍被拦截，且 playwright 可用，则再尝试一次（自动兜底） pw_resp = _pygen_playwright_fetch(method, url, headers=headers, data=kwargs.get("data"), json=kwargs.get("json"), timeout=int(kwargs.get("timeout") or 30)) if pw_resp is not None: return pw_resp except Exception: # 兜底失败则返回原始响应，交由上层处理 return resp return resp _pygen_requests.sessions.Session.request = _patched _pygen_install_requests_patch() # === PyGen 注入结束 === import os import json import time import re from datetime import datetime, timedelta from urllib.parse import urljoin from bs4 import BeautifulSoup from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright # ================= 配置区域 ================= OUTPUT_DIR = r"d:\llm_mcp_genpy\pygen\output" TARGET_URL = "https://www.news.bundesbank.de/news-de" MAX_ITEMS = 5 # 任务目标：前5条 # ================= 辅助函数 ================= def parse_german_relative_date(date_str): """ 解析德语相对时间字符串，转换为 YYYY-MM-DD 格式 例如: "vor 8 Stunden", "vor 2 Tagen", "Gestern" """ if not date_str: return datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d") now = datetime.now() date_str = date_str.strip().lower() try: if "gestern" in date_str: return (now - timedelta(days=1)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d") if "heute" in date_str or "gerade" in date_str: return now.strftime("%Y-%m-%d") # 提取数字 num_match = re.search(r'(\d+)', date_str) if num_match: val = int(num_match.group(1)) if "stunde" in date_str: # hours return (now - timedelta(hours=val)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d") elif "tag" in date_str: # days return (now - timedelta(days=val)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d") elif "minute" in date_str: # minutes return (now - timedelta(minutes=val)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d") elif "woche" in date_str: # weeks return (now - timedelta(weeks=val)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d") elif "monat" in date_str: # months (approx) return (now - timedelta(days=val*30)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d") # 尝试解析绝对日期格式 (如果有) # 这里的 widget 主要是相对时间，但也防备绝对时间 return now.strftime("%Y-%m-%d") except Exception as e: print(f"日期解析错误 '{date_str}': {e}") return now.strftime("%Y-%m-%d") def clean_html_content(html_content, base_url): """清洗 HTML 内容，修复相对链接""" if not html_content: return "" try: soup = BeautifulSoup(html_content, 'html.parser') # 修复图片链接 for img in soup.find_all('img'): if img.get('src'): img['src'] = urljoin(base_url, img['src']) # 修复超链接 for a in soup.find_all('a'): if a.get('href'): a['href'] = urljoin(base_url, a['href']) return str(soup) except Exception: return html_content def save_results(articles, output_dir): """保存结果为 JSON""" os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True) timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S") filename = f"bundesbank_social_news_{timestamp}.json" output_path = os.path.join(output_dir, filename) result = { "total": len(articles), "crawlTime": datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "articles": articles } with open(output_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f: json.dump(result, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) print(f"✅ 成功保存 {len(articles)} 条数据到: {output_path}") # ================= 核心爬虫逻辑 ================= def crawl_bundesbank_news(): print(f"🚀 开始爬取: {TARGET_URL}") articles = [] with sync_playwright() as p: # 启动浏览器 (配置反爬参数) browser = p.chromium.launch( headless=True, # 调试时可设为 False args=["--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled"] ) context = browser.new_context( viewport={'width': 1920, 'height': 1080}, user_agent="Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36" ) page = context.new_page() try: page.goto(TARGET_URL, wait_until="domcontentloaded") # 1. 等待 Shadow Host 出现 print("⏳ 等待 Widget 加载...") shadow_host_selector = "#stage-widget" page.wait_for_selector(shadow_host_selector, timeout=20000) # 2. 等待 Shadow DOM 内部内容渲染 # 由于无法直接 wait_for_selector Shadow DOM 内部元素，我们用轮询检查 print("⏳ 等待 Shadow DOM 内容渲染...") for i in range(10): # 获取 Shadow Root 的 innerHTML shadow_html = page.evaluate("""() => { const host = document.querySelector('#stage-widget'); return host && host.shadowRoot ? host.shadowRoot.innerHTML : ''; }""") # 检查是否有内容 (根据截图，会有 "vor" 这样的时间词，或者 "Deutsche Bundesbank") if shadow_html and ("vor" in shadow_html or "Deutsche Bundesbank" in shadow_html): print("✅ 检测到 Shadow DOM 内容已加载") break time.sleep(1) else: print("⚠️ 警告: Shadow DOM 内容可能未完全加载") # 3. 提取 Shadow DOM 的 HTML 进行解析 # 相比在 JS 中提取，把 HTML 拿出来用 BeautifulSoup 解析更稳健，容易调试 shadow_html = page.evaluate("""() => { const host = document.querySelector('#stage-widget'); return host && host.shadowRoot ? host.shadowRoot.innerHTML : ''; }""") if not shadow_html: print("❌ 无法获取 Shadow DOM 内容") return [] # 4. 解析 HTML soup = BeautifulSoup(shadow_html, 'html.parser') # 策略：找到所有卡片 # 观察截图和常见 Widget 结构，卡片通常是 article 或 div # 我们通过寻找包含 "vor ..." (时间) 的元素，然后向上找父容器来定位卡片 # 查找所有包含时间关键词的文本节点 # 常见的德语相对时间词: vor, Gestern, Heute time_pattern = re.compile(r'(vor\s+\d+\s+(Stunde|Tag|Minute)|Gestern|Heute)', re.IGNORECASE) potential_cards = [] # 遍历所有文本节点寻找时间，然后定位卡片 for text_node in soup.find_all(string=time_pattern): # 向上寻找合适的容器 (通常是 article 或带有特定 class 的 div) # 这里我们向上找几层，直到找到一个包含较多内容的块 parent = text_node.parent card = None # 向上查找最多 5 层 curr = parent for _ in range(5): if curr is None: break # 简单的启发式：如果这个元素包含 img 或者是 article 标签，或者包含较长文本，可能是卡片 if curr.name == 'article' or (curr.name == 'div' and len(curr.get_text(strip=True)) > 50): card = curr # 继续向上找，看有没有更大的容器（有时候找到的是内容区而不是整个卡片） # 但为了避免找到整个列表，我们找到第一个像样的容器就停止 if curr.name == 'article': # article 标签优先级最高 break curr = curr.parent if card and card not in potential_cards: potential_cards.append(card) print(f"🔍 找到 {len(potential_cards)} 个潜在新闻卡片") # 5. 提取数据 for i, card in enumerate(potential_cards): if i >= MAX_ITEMS: break try: # 提取原始文本 full_text = card.get_text(" ", strip=True) # 提取时间 date_str = "" date_match = time_pattern.search(full_text) if date_match: date_str = date_match.group(0) # 提取链接 (优先找卡片内的链接) link_tag = card.find('a', href=True) source_url = urljoin(TARGET_URL, link_tag['href']) if link_tag else TARGET_URL # 提取图片 img_tag = card.find('img') img_html = "" if img_tag and img_tag.get('src'): src = urljoin(TARGET_URL, img_tag['src']) img_html = f'' # 提取正文 (去除时间和来源等杂讯) # 简单处理：将整个卡片的 HTML 作为内容，或者只取文本 # 为了保留格式，我们取 HTML，但要清洗 content_html = clean_html_content(str(card), TARGET_URL) # 提取标题 (取正文前 50 个字) # 去除 "Deutsche Bundesbank" 和 时间字符串 clean_text = full_text.replace("Deutsche Bundesbank", "").replace(date_str, "").strip() title = clean_text[:60] + "..." if len(clean_text) > 60 else clean_text if not title: title = "Deutsche Bundesbank Social Media Post" article = { "id": str(i + 1), "title": title, "date": parse_german_relative_date(date_str), "original_date": date_str, # 保留原始时间字符串以便核对 "author": "Deutsche Bundesbank", "source": "Bundesbank Social Media", "sourceUrl": source_url, "summary": clean_text[:100] + "...", "content": content_html } articles.append(article) print(f" [提取成功] {article['date']} - {article['title']}") except Exception as e: print(f" [提取失败] 卡片 {i+1}: {e}") continue except Exception as e: print(f"❌ 爬取过程中发生错误: {e}") finally: browser.close() return articles def main(): # 确保输出目录存在 if not os.path.exists(OUTPUT_DIR): os.makedirs(OUTPUT_DIR) # 执行爬取 articles = crawl_bundesbank_news() # 保存结果 if articles: save_results(articles, OUTPUT_DIR) else: print("⚠️ 未爬取到任何数据，请检查页面结构或网络连接。") if __name__ == "__main__": main()
